data.name: Carling
data.gender_notes: Carling is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'karlos' which means 'dear' or 'darling'. In the New Testament, the name Carline is borne by a woman who welcomed Jesus and his disciples into her home (Luke 8:2–3). The name Carling carries the meaning “Darling, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carling usually hope their child will grow to embody darling, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with love and affection.
data.etymology: Carling belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Darling, Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carling total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קרלינג
in_hebrew.meaning: קריית מקורית לנצרות, נגזרת משם גרמני עתיק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קרלינג מקורו בשם גרמני עתיק, קרל, שפירושו 'אדם חופשי'. השם קרלינג הוא שם פטרוני שפירושו 'צאצא של קרל'. השם קרל הוא שורש השם קרלינג, והוא נמצא גם בברית החדשה כשמו של אחד מהאבות של ישו. השם קרלינג משמש גם כחלק מהמסורת הנוצרית, במיוחד בקרב הקתולים והאנגליקנים.

in_greek.name: Κάρλινγκ
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα, πιθανόν από το γερμανικό 'karl', που σημαίνει 'ελεύθερος άνθρωπος'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κάρλινγκ πιθανόν να προέρχεται από το γερμανικό 'karl', που σημαίνει 'ελεύθερος άνθρωπος'. Το όνομα 'Κάρλος' ή 'Καρλ' ήταν δημοφιλές στην Ευρώπη κατά τη Μεσαίωνα και συνδέθηκε με τον Άγιο Καρλομάγνο. Στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Κάρλινγκ μπορεί να συσχετίζεται με την έννοια της ελευθερίας και της ανεξαρτησίας.

in_latin.name: Carling
in_latin.meaning: Christianum nomen, fortasse a Germanico 'karl' derivatum, quod significat 'homo liber'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Carling Christianum est, quod fortasse a Germanico 'karl' derivatum est, quod significat 'homo liber'. Nomen 'Carolus' seu 'Karl' in Europa mediaevali populare erat et cum Carolo Magno coniunctum est. In traditione Ecclesiae Catholicae, nomen Carling notionem libertatis et independentiae habet.

in_english.name: Carling
in_english.meaning: Derived from Germanic 'karl', meaning 'free man', associated with Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Carling originates from the Germanic term 'karl', meaning 'free man'. It is associated with Christian tradition, particularly among Catholics and Anglicans. The name Charles or Karl was popular in Europe during the Middle Ages and linked to Charlemagne. Carling signifies freedom, independence, and strong personality traits.
